name: YNX DEX

minOS.web: modern browser with ES2022 and PWA support

recoveredCandidate.scope: constant-product contracts, indexer, JavaScript SDK, and Web/PWA preview

consensusDexV13.scope: native assets, balances, constant-product pools, exact-input/output swaps, add/remove liquidity, deterministic signed actions, Gateway evidence queries, persistent restart equality and Wallet web authorization binding
consensusDexV13.evidence: go test -race ./internal/consensus ./internal/bftgateway; npm test --prefix apps/dex; npm test --prefix packages/wallet-auth; npm test --prefix apps/wallet

strategyVault.scope: immutable owner/engine vault, typed CPMM and direct StableSwap exact-input/exact-output/add/remove actions, exact pool-kind permissions, mandate limits, oracle/depeg checks, pause/revoke/kill, atomic taxed-token rejection, emergency exit, no fee charging

executionAdapter.scope: typed CPMM and direct StableSwap Vault requests, exact Wallet approval digest, injected limited-engine transport, direct/indexed reconciliation, fail-closed gas/fee/oracle/risk snapshots, explicit CPMM collect capability, bounded compound and stepwise rebalance
executionAdapter.evidence: npm test --prefix sdk/dex; npm run check --prefix sdk/dex

vaultIndexer.scope: confirmed typed CPMM/StableSwap/Vault/FairFlow/LP-Protection ingestion including direct StableSwap Vault actions, state schema v5, all-source-bound cursor v6, authenticated legacy migration with exact backups, shared reorg recovery and source-labelled API

indexerRecovery.scope: immutable HMAC-authenticated state and cursor point-in-time bundle, exact source/deployment bindings, isolated empty-destination restore, tamper and wrong-binding rejection, measured local backup/restore/verification timing

fairFlow.scope: on-chain Intent lifecycle, uniform clearing price, solver-funded rebate, commit/reveal competition, verified surplus score, CoW net settlement, exact external inventory, cancellation abort, native bond/reputation, objective slashing, all-stage confirmed indexing and exact canonical Wallet-approved SDK Intent requests
fairFlow.evidence: npm run dex:fairflow:test; npm test --prefix sdk/dex; go test -race ./internal/dex ./cmd/ynx-dex-indexerd

lpProtection.scope: separate protected CPMM Factory, immutable Oracle policy, bounded component fees, depeg swap circuit breaker, delayed configuration, permissionless LP exit, fixed confirmed event indexing/API and exact source-labelled SDK quote/reconciliation
lpProtection.evidence: npm run dex:lp-protection:test; npm test --prefix sdk/dex; go test -race ./internal/dex ./cmd/ynx-dex-indexerd

stableSwap.scope: separate clean-room two-asset StableSwap Factory/Pool family, 6/8/18-decimal normalization, immutable amplification and fee, proportional fungible LP shares, exact-input/output Router/Quoter compatibility, typed schema/cursor v5 indexing, fresh-state SDK quoting, direct Strategy Vault swap/add/remove routing, and PWA CPMM-math exclusion
stableSwap.evidence: npm run dex:stable:test; npm run dex:vault:test; npm test --prefix sdk/dex; go test -race ./internal/dex ./cmd/ynx-dex-indexerd; npm test --prefix apps/dex

knownLimitations: The consensus DEX v13 core and recovered EVM candidate are implemented and tested locally, but the full objective remains incomplete until public deployment, independently reviewed assets, signed transaction handoff and public receipts exist.
No public YNX Testnet v13 DEX deployment, reviewed pools, swaps, or LP proofs exist yet.

FairFlow is a local unaudited candidate: UI, Sybil and collusion controls, partial fills, external-route proof and cross-chain settlement are absent; Indexer and SDK paths are local-only and have no public chain evidence.

LP Protection is a local unaudited protected-CPMM candidate: UI presentation, reviewed live Oracle adapter, LVR-aware auction, inventory/range guidance and public chain evidence are absent; Indexer and SDK paths are local-only.

StableSwap is a local unaudited and undeployed candidate: direct Strategy Vault swap/add/remove routing is locally tested, but no reviewed stable assets, external peg/rate Oracle, depeg pause, dedicated PWA transaction path, verified bytecode, pools, liquidity or public receipts exist; multi-hop Vault execution is intentionally split into separately approved direct actions and the PWA intentionally presents indexed Stable pools read-only.
The exact DEX web tuple is approved in the source central registry and Wallet client, but no updated production-signed Wallet release or public Product Session gateway evidence exists.
No independent third-party smart-contract audit has been completed.
CPMM LP fees are embedded in reserves; there is no separate LP collect method, and compound/rebalance require caller-supplied amounts plus sequential Wallet approvals.
Staging, public deployment, hosted download, production signing, and store release are absent.

The Web/PWA completes signed Wallet identity authorization and deterministic swap review, but DEX action signing and broadcasting remain unavailable until the public v13 Gateway and updated Wallet release are validated.
